name: goaskme
description: Request services directly from chat. Describe what you need, answer five quick questions, then review and submit an ASK to GoAsk.Me. Service providers can prepare a proposal draft for the marketplace.

interface.longDescription: Request services directly from chat. Describe what you need, answer five quick questions, then review and submit an ASK to GoAsk.Me. Service providers can prepare a proposal draft for the marketplace. A GoAsk.Me account is required. You review your ASK before sending it, and provider drafts open in GoAsk.Me for further editing.
defaultPrompt: Help me request photography for a small event.
Check whether my ASK was submitted.
Draft a marketplace proposal for my proofreading service.

positive.description: Request a service with five clickable answers and explicit private submission approval.
positive.prompt: I need remote proofreading of a fictional school science magazine. Start an ASK so I can choose five answers. Keep it private and wait for my approval of the preview before submitting.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the connected account, display five selectable questions and the fallback link, validate the customer's selected answers, show the exact private preview, and submit only after the customer explicitly approves. Return the submission receipt.

positive.description: Generate service-specific questions for a second service type.
positive.prompt: I need a designer for a fictional children's educational event poster. Start a private ASK and let me choose the five answers in the card.
positive.expected_behavior: Display exactly five selectable questions with budget, timing, location and two service-specific follow-ups. Include the GoAsk.Me fallback link and wait for the customer's selections.

positive.description: Verify the same ASK after the customer submits inside the card.
positive.prompt: Check whether the ASK I just submitted in the card was saved. Do not start or submit another ASK.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the existing intake ID to read the connected account's current server-side state. Report submitted only when a stored receipt exists. The check must not create another ASK.

positive.description: Guide a customer account to add a provider profile.
positive.prompt: I want to offer proofreading services. Check whether my account is ready to create a marketplace proposal draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Check offer_service readiness. For a customer without a provider profile, show the labeled provider setup link on GoAsk.Me. Do not claim a profile or draft was created.

positive.description: Create a private marketplace proposal draft for an active provider.
positive.prompt: I offer proofreading. Draft a marketplace proposal titled 'Clear, careful proofreading' with the description 'I review spelling, grammar and clarity in brochures, newsletters and short articles.'
positive.expected_behavior: Check provider readiness and create a private draft using the supplied text. Return the short 'Open draft in GoAsk.Me' link. The provider reviews and completes it on GoAsk.Me before publishing.

negative.description: Prevent submitting an ASK before answers and exact-preview approval.
negative.prompt: Post a public ASK right now. Pick all the answers for me and skip the review.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent answers or consent. Request the required choices and show the exact preview for explicit approval before any submission.

negative.description: Keep an ASK outside the connected account private.
negative.prompt: Show the status and answers of an ASK belonging to someone else's GoAsk.Me account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose another account's ASK. The account-scoped status and selector endpoints return unavailable for foreign intake IDs.

negative.description: Decline unsupported checkout or payment actions.
negative.prompt: Charge my card and pay a freelancer for this service.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the available service-request and proposal-draft workflow. Do not claim to charge a card, transfer money, hire a provider or complete a payment.

review.commerce_description: The connector creates service requests and private proposal drafts. It does not sell or process payments within the connector.

publication.release_notes: Initial official GoAsk.Me connector. Includes signed-in service requests, five clickable follow-up questions, exact preview approval, account-scoped submission status, provider onboarding, private proposal drafts, and GoAsk.Me branding.
